batch: Revamp S2 Customer Work: Wave 4, decision card step 4, the two screens (D-01 to D-10)
kind: The public /decision-card page, the owner panel inside the saved mission page and the shared bare-page predicate. Behind CORRIDRA_SHARE_CARD, default off. No schema, route, migration or switch change.
findingsNote: No gap is created or changed. Building does not enable: enabling needs the recorded privacy review, the installed module and the owner (ADR-076 item 6).
status: Built on branch revamp/customer over main after the money PR. CI on the exact pushed head is the verifier; see the pull request for its result.
changedFiles: apps/web/components/ux/shell-header.tsx, site-footer-place.tsx and corner-dock.tsx: one early return each so a bare page draws no header, footer or help dock (the header is the component that asks /api/*/get-session). These three belong to S3; the change is one guard each.

apps/web/app/account/missions/decision-history.tsx, saved-commercial-report.tsx and [resourceId]/page.tsx: a `decisionCards` flag, read on the server, mounts the owner panel inside the approved decisions. With the switch off nothing is mounted.

decisions.realWorkspace: Ruled by the Guardian (4 Nov 2026): use the saved report's own synthetic flag. With the switch on and the flag false the panel shows only 'Decision cards are available for sample workspaces only.' with no control, link, count or preview. On a sample report any denied or failed state answer, or canShare false, means the panel is absent, never that line and never a disabled panel. Both cases are tested (D-07 real workspace, D-09 sub-case).
decisions.linkKeptInMemory: The link returned by create is held in memory only and dropped on pagehide; it is never stored. After a reload the card is listed without its link.
decisions.everyAnswerOneMessage: On the public page a network failure, a 429, a 503, a malformed fragment and an unknown answer all show 'This link is not available.'
decisions.withdrawOnlyActive: State lists only the caller's own cards, and Withdraw is offered only for an active one.
